text.北欧ヴィンテージやPoul Kjaerholm（ポール・ケアホルム）の家具など、: A fine apartment renovation where real things are shown at their best — Scandinavian vintage, furniture by Poul Kjærholm. It occupies the ground floor of a low-rise vintage block on the high ground of Shimazuyama, in the quiet residential Jonan Gozan district. Walls and ceilings finished in lime plaster, and a terrace deck in the same solid teak as the living room, join the home to its private garden and make an open, settled space. Niches are set into the limestone wall facing the entrance and into the living-room fireplace, so that something can be put out for each season. With a jacuzzi bath among other things, this is a home appointed with the ease of a detached house.
text.リビングと同じ無垢チークを使用。古くから船のデッキなどに使われてきたチーク材は、: The same solid teak as the living room. Teak has been used for ships' decks for centuries, and with regular maintenance it can be used outdoors. Set level with the living-room floor, it is designed to read as an extension of the room.
